sections.question: Including premiums from the Canadian business Travelers sold in the first quarter of 2026, by what percentage did its personal automobile net written premiums change from the second quarter of 2025 to the second quarter of 2026? Give the sign, to one decimal place.
sections.reasoning:
Step 1. Doc 8 (Personal Insurance net written premiums table): domestic Automobile net written premiums were 1,858 in the second quarter of 2026 and 1,968 in the second quarter of 2025. The International row shows 178 for the 2025 quarter and nothing for 2026, and the text says the prior year quarter "included $178 million related to the Canadian operations divested by the Company in the first quarter of 2026".
Step 2. Doc 3 (Selected Statistics - Personal Insurance - Automobile): automobile net written premiums for 2Q2025 were 2,074, while the Net Written Premiums - Personal Insurance page shows domestic Automobile of 1,968 for 2Q2025. 2,074 - 1,968 = 106
Step 3. Doc 3 (Selected Statistics - Personal Insurance - Homeowners and Other): net written premiums for 2Q2025 were 2,592 against domestic Homeowners and Other of 2,520. 2,592 - 2,520 = 72
Step 4. Doc 3: 106 + 72 = 178, the International total for 2Q2025, so the product-line pages include the Canadian business and its automobile premiums in that quarter were 106.
Step 5. Doc 8 and Doc 3: 1,858 - 2,074 = -216
Step 6. -216 / 2,074 = -10.4% (to one decimal place)
